summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Galiano Gold Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its Annual General and Special Meeting held on June 11, 2026. The filing discloses voting outcomes on routine matters: fixing the number of directors at eight, electing eight director nominees, reappointing Ernst & Young as auditor, approving the Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. All resolutions passed with majority shareholder support. There is no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign; this is a routine governance update.
